_comment: macOS audio routing reference using BlackHole + Loopback (or SoundSource). See modules/audio-production/setup/manual.md.

virtual_devices.name: BlackHole 2ch
virtual_devices.purpose: AI/TTS voice output → captured by OBS as a source

virtual_devices.name: BlackHole 16ch (optional)
virtual_devices.purpose: Multi-channel routing if using Loopback or Audio Hijack

routing.system_output: BlackHole 2ch (so OBS can capture desktop audio)
routing.discord_input: Your physical mic (USB or interface); optionally a dedicated mix-minus input excluding CALL-IN
routing.ai_tts_output: BlackHole 2ch (same as desktop, or use Loopback for dedicated bus)

loopback_alternative._comment: Rogue Amoeba Loopback ($99) provides a GUI for virtual devices and routing. Replaces the BlackHole + manual config approach. Recommended for non-technical users.

notes: macOS audio routing is more limited than Windows VoiceMeeter.
For full bus isolation (6 buses like the Windows setup), use Loopback or Audio Hijack.
BlackHole alone gives you 1-2 virtual devices — enough for basic OBS capture.
Multi-Output Device in Audio MIDI Setup can split headphone monitoring from capture.

Discord Input Device captures your physical microphone by default; Built-in Output is a playback device. If sharing other sources through a virtual input, exclude the Discord return audio from that input.
